digest.component_or_area: RP-02 BindingStore lifecycle and create recovery
propositions: Once Jira returns a create key, the known key must be persisted on the still-pending RP-02 entry before any label is attached to enable deterministic recovery from crashes in the create-to-label window

The canonical rebar-id label is the durable remote identity floor and must be attached before optional entity property attempts; property unsupported/forbidden failures must not erase a successful label
Local confirmation via bind_confirm must occur last, after the label is attached and optional property is attempted, while the durable key was already recorded before label attachment
Any post-create failure (key save, label, property, or confirmation) must preserve the remote issue without deletion and retain recovery evidence with the known key
The known key and confirmation must persist only through the RP-02 BindingStore facade; no separate binding writer should be created
Other lifecycle intents must execute only after their remote postconditions are proven
